{{Quote|Chalactans believe that all the natural laws of the universe also exist within us.|[[Prithi]]|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 5">[[Star Wars (2013) 5|''Star Wars'' (2013) 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Chalactans''' were a very peaceful and spiritual [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> native to the planet [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]].<ref name="DB-Billaba" /><ref name="DB-Labooda" /><ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="TEA" /> They were universally respected,<ref name="TEA" /> and famous for their spiritual order, the [[Chalactan Adepts/Legends|Chalactan Adepts]].<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="FaDCR" /> On Chalacta, Chalactans lived in small farms and cities.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|On the Mid Rim world of Chalacta, Senator Yudrish Sedran has consulted the Chalactan Temple of Illumination for direction, adopting a strong anti-Military Creation Act stance that has been anecdotally supported by Chalactan Jedi Depa Billaba and Sar Labooda.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref>}}
Chalacta was once an uninhabited planet until it was colonized by the Chalactan Adepts.<ref name="FaDCR" />

There were at least four prominent Chalactan [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]: [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Councilor]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] who fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]],<ref name="DB-Billaba" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Simms]],<ref name="R:ItU">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sar Labooda/Legends|Sar Labooda]],<ref name="DB-Labooda" /> and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Klossi Anno]].<ref name="DL:TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Chalactans were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Yudrish Sedran/Legends|Yudrish Sedran]], who opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] after consulting the wisdom of the Chalactan [[Temple of Illumination]].<ref name="HNN55" /><ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chalactans attire and look seem to take heavy influence from Indian culture. In ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', it is stated that another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], has "Chalactan tattoos" on her face. In the [[MedStar Duology]], however, this fact has been corrected. Officially, Offee's tattoos are traditionally [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]]. It was also corrected when the contents of ''Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary'' were reprinted in ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''.
